about: Pad finishes plated over the copper a mask opening exposes, and the legend ink: each finish's look (linear-sRGB F0, metallic, perceptual roughness; metals store IOR 1.5, which Solidcraft requires and ignores) and its plated thickness. The 3D view draws a finish at the middle of the published range (the layers' lows and highs summed). Sources are in docs/materials.md (Pad finishes, Silkscreen colour); est. marks an estimate.

look.name: ENIG gold
look.note: ENIG pad F0 (est.): the gold F0 (1.000, 0.782, 0.344; Johnson & Christy 1972 via Hoffman's table) with a little nickel showing through the 0.04-0.10 um immersion gold (about 85 % Au over 15 % Ni F0 0.660, 0.609, 0.526: the gold is only 1-2 penetration depths thick), kept saturated so the finish reads gold, not khaki.

thickness.source: JLCPCB's surface-finish page (read 2026-11-11): nickel 3-6 um, gold 0.025-0.05 um.

look.name: HASL tin-lead
look.note: Eutectic tin-lead (Sn63Pb37) F0: about 30 % lead by volume, which reflects less than tin (est.). Eutectic tin-lead freezes bright.

thickness.source: LC-PCB's process capability table (read 2026-11-11), row 63: HASL, leaded and lead-free, 2-40 um.

look.name: Lead-free HASL tin
look.note: Tin F0 of a hot-air levelled pad, flat across the visible (est.; below polished tin, for its oxide film; Palik's Sn n, k to confirm). Lead-free tin alloys freeze duller and grainier than tin-lead.

thickness.source: LC-PCB's process capability table (read 2026-11-11), row 63: HASL, leaded and lead-free, 2-40 um.

look.name: OSP copper
look.note: A sub-micrometre transparent film over micro-etched, fresh copper: bare Cu F0 (Johnson & Christy 1972 via Hoffman's table); roughness est.

thickness.source: LC-PCB's process capability table (read 2026-11-11), row 64: film 0.2-0.3 um.

look.name: Immersion silver
look.note: Silver F0 (Hoffman's table, from measured optical constants); immersion silver is many optical penetration depths thick. Roughness est.

thickness.source: LC-PCB's process capability table (read 2026-11-11), row 66: silver 0.2-0.4 um.

legend_ink.name: Epoxy legend ink
legend_ink.note: Matte epoxy legend ink, diffuse reflectance (est.; TiO2-filled white, carbon black, chrome-free yellow) and its matte roughness (est.); epoxy index 1.55 (handbook values). The grain shows at half strength: at full strength it read as blotchy dirt at mid zoom (realism review v4). Thickness est.: screen-printed and inkjet legend is 10-25 um.
